description.en: Berlin-based developer of the Ableton Live DAW and the Push hardware.
description.ko: 베를린에 본사를 둔 DAW Ableton Live와 Push 하드웨어 개발사입니다.

description.en: Ableton's DAW for macOS and Windows, sold as Intro, Standard and Suite editions; Live 12 is the current major version.
description.ko: Ableton이 만든 macOS·Windows용 DAW로 Intro·Standard·Suite 에디션이 있으며 현재 메이저 버전은 Live 12입니다.

facts.note: Released 2026-09-15.
Live 12: macOS 11.7.10 Big Sur through macOS 27 (Apple silicon) / through macOS 26 (Intel).
Live 12: Windows 10 version 22H2 or Windows 11 version 22H2 or higher; CPU must support AVX2; Windows on Arm via Prism emulation.
Live 12 and Live 11.1+ macOS Universal build runs natively; Live 11.0 and 10 need Rosetta.

facts.v: One-time purchase (Intro, Standard, Suite); Suite also as rent-to-own over 24 monthly payments

description.en: Apple's DAW for the Mac (a separate iPad version exists). It hosts Audio Units plug-ins only.
description.ko: Apple의 Mac용 DAW입니다(iPad용 버전은 별도). 서드파티 플러그인은 Audio Units만 지원합니다.

facts.note: Released 2026-08-13 per the Mac App Store version history.
Release notes distinguish native mode from Rosetta mode; Intel Macs are also supported.

facts.v: One-time purchase on the Mac App Store, or included in an Apple Creator Studio subscription

description.en: Image-Line's DAW for Windows and macOS, sold as editions with lifetime free updates.
description.ko: Image-Line의 Windows·macOS용 DAW로, 에디션 구매 시 평생 무료 업데이트를 제공합니다.

facts.note: Build 26.1.6.5639 (Windows) / 26.1.6.5406 (macOS) on the download page.
Intel and AMD CPUs; ARM is not supported.
Windows: 32/64-bit VST 1/2, VST3, CLAP; macOS: 64-bit VST 1/2, VST3, AU, CLAP.

facts.v: One-time purchase per edition with lifetime free updates; rent-to-own (12 payments) also offered

description.en: German developer of Cubase, Nuendo, Dorico and WaveLab, and maker of the UR series audio interfaces.
description.ko: Cubase·Nuendo·Dorico·WaveLab 개발사이자 UR 시리즈 오디오 인터페이스 제조사인 독일 회사입니다.

description.en: Steinberg's DAW for Windows and macOS, sold in Pro, Artist and Elements editions (AI and LE ship with hardware). Cubase 15 is the current version.
description.ko: Steinberg의 Windows·macOS용 DAW로 Pro·Artist·Elements 에디션이 있으며(AI·LE는 하드웨어 번들) 현재 버전은 Cubase 15입니다.

facts.note: Most recent Cubase 15 version listed in Steinberg's macOS Tahoe chart (2026/07/22); a newer maintenance update may exist.
Cubase 15: macOS Sequoia, Sonoma, Tahoe.
Cubase 15: 64-bit Windows 10 22H2 or higher, 64-bit Windows 11 24H2 or higher; Windows on Arm processors listed.
"Native App, Rosetta 2 App".
VST 2 is disabled by default in Cubase 14/15; on macOS VST 2 works only with Cubase in Rosetta mode.
